description: Hermes provides the `@InjectLogger` annotation for zero-boilerplate logger injection using compile-time annotation processing.

description: MDC provides thread-local storage for contextual information that should be included in all log statements within a thread.

title: Markers
description: Markers allow you to tag log statements with special labels for filtering and routing purposes.

description: Hermes uses SLF4J-style `{}` placeholders for efficient message formatting with zero-allocation optimization.

description: Appenders control where log events are written. Hermes provides several built-in appenders with support for custom implementations.

title: Async Logging
description: Async logging provides high-throughput, non-blocking log processing using LMAX Disruptor.

title: JSON Logging
description: JSON logging outputs structured log data ideal for log aggregation, analysis, and centralized logging systems.

title: Layouts
description: Layouts format log events into strings. Hermes provides flexible pattern-based and JSON layouts.

title: Logstash Integration
description: Hermes provides native Logstash integration for centralized logging with structured JSON events sent over TCP.

title: GraalVM Native Image
description: Hermes is fully compatible with GraalVM Native Image, enabling AOT compilation to native executables with zero configuration.

title: Kotlin DSL
description: Hermes provides idiomatic Kotlin extensions for a more natural logging experience in Kotlin projects.

title: Spring Boot Integration
description: Hermes provides native Spring Boot integration through auto-configuration and YAML-based configuration.
